---
title: "Selected images only (default)"
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true
filters:
  - path: ../../_filters/show-source.lua
    at: pre-ast
  - panzoom
panzoom:
  hint: false
---

## About

Only images with the `.panzoom` class or the `#| classes: panzoom` cell
option open in panzoom.
The document doesn't turn lightbox on, so it applies only where a cell asks
for it with `#| lightbox:` options (cases 6 and 7). The [lightbox
version](a-lightbox.html) has the same cases without panzoom. Compare each
case with the same number there.

## 1. Single image {#c1 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![A markdown image with `.panzoom` with a description and `desc-position="left"`. It opens in panzoom, with the description below the caption, since panzoom has no `desc-position`.](../../images/mv-0.jpg){.panzoom description="Chilmark has _some_ of the best beaches. **credit:** [Chilmark Beach](https://unsplash.com/photos/VBDJGOMCwps)" desc-position="left"}
```

## 2. Gallery in a layout {#c2 expect-open="nothing panzoom nothing"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {layout="[[1, 1], [1]]"}
![Aquinnah, without `.panzoom`. With no lightbox on the page, clicking it does nothing.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="The waves break off Aquinnah."}

![Oak Bluffs, the only one of the three with `.panzoom`. It opens in panzoom on its own.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom group="elsewhere" description="Gingerbread cottages."}

![Vineyard lighthouse, without `.panzoom`. Clicking it does nothing.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){group="elsewhere" description="Edgartown Lighthouse."}
:::
```

## 3. Math {#c3 expect-open="panzoom"}

A markdown image with `.panzoom` with math in its caption and description.
It opens in panzoom with both typeset.

```{.markdown .show-source}
![Caption with math $e^{i\pi}+1=0$](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom description="Description with math $\\int_0^1 x^2\\,dx = 1/3$"}
```

## 4. Markdown subfigures {#c4 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
::: {#fig-md-sub layout-ncol=2}
![Sub A](../../images/mv-1.jpg){#fig-md-a .panzoom}

![Sub B](../../images/mv-2.jpg){#fig-md-b .panzoom}

Two markdown subfigures with `.panzoom`, the first cross-referenced here (see @fig-md-a). They open in panzoom as a two-image gallery.
:::
```

## 5. R subfigures {#c5 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-r-sub
#| fig-cap: "Two subfigures from one R cell with `classes: panzoom`. They open in panzoom as a two-image gallery."
#| fig-subcap: ["Pressure", "Cars"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| classes: panzoom

plot(pressure)
plot(cars)
```

## 6. Cell options {#c6 expect-open="panzoom glightbox"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "An R cell with `classes: panzoom`, with lightbox options too. It opens in panzoom on its own, and its lightbox options are dropped."
#| classes: panzoom
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: This is 1 to 10 plot

plot(1:10, rnorm(10))
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "An R cell with only lightbox options, which turn lightbox on for this cell. It opens in lightbox on its own."
#| lightbox:
#|   group: r-graph
#|   description: We see our cars data above

plot(cars)
```

## 7. Two plots in one cell {#c7 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{r}
#| classes: panzoom
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "One R cell with `classes: panzoom`, two plots, and lightbox options. panzoom drops the lightbox options, so this plot opens in panzoom on its own."
#|   - "The second plot of the cell. It also opens in panzoom on its own."
#| lightbox:
#|   group: cars
#|   description:
#|     - Description for first graph
#|     - Description for second graph

plot(mtcars)
plot(cars)
```

## 8. Opt out {#c8 expect-open="nothing"}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "An R cell with `lightbox: false`. Clicking it does nothing."
#| lightbox: false

plot(mtcars)
```

## 9. Image in a link {#c9 expect-open="navigation"}

An image with `.panzoom` inside a link. panzoom leaves images in links alone, so
clicking it follows the link.

```{.markdown .show-source}
[![Linked image](../../images/mv-4.jpg){.panzoom width=30%}](https://quarto.org)
```

## 10. Margin image {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

```{.markdown .show-source}
![A markdown image with `.panzoom` in the margin. It opens in panzoom.](../../images/mv-3.jpg){.panzoom .column-margin}
```

## 11. Inline image {#c11 expect-open="panzoom"}

An image with `.panzoom` inside a sentence. It opens in panzoom.

```{.markdown .show-source}
Some text with an inline image ![](../../images/mv-2.jpg){.panzoom width=60px} in the middle.
```

## 12. Plain R figure {#c12 expect-open="nothing"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-plain
#| fig-cap: "A cross-referenced R figure with no options. With no lightbox on the page, clicking it does nothing."

image(volcano)
```
